lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Slotted plate to middle plate, about 90 deg. Perpendicular sections at 5/25/50/75% put the line on the convex outer arc apex (nearest point 0.02-0.14 mm; inner skin about 2.3-2.5 mm away along the bisector). The line is parallel to the fold. It runs t 0-39.0 mm, and the fold points run t -0.9 to 39.4 mm, so it covers about 98% of the full 40 mm width.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Middle plate to rounded tab, about 90 deg. Sections at 5/25/50/75% put the line on the outer apex (nearest point 0.02-0.10 mm; inner skin about 2.3 mm inside). The line is parallel to the fold. It runs t 0-24.1 mm, and the fold points run t -0.5 to 24.8 mm, so it covers about 97% of the tab-width fold.
